bounds.domain: Two logical request IDs, three initial credit units, one or two unit quotes, at most two provider calls per request, one account and mutable plan/credential standing.
bounds.atomicity: Admission and settlement rely on the existing authoritative organization billing owner. Maps replay receipts precede provider dispatch.
bounds.progress: Progress assumes weak fairness of provider observation and settlement. The no-fairness property is expected to produce a liveness counterexample.

limitations: Unit prices abstract the published Google SKU prices; floating-point money arithmetic is covered by the existing billing engine, not this model.
The model does not prove transport behavior or cross-process implementation refinement. Route orchestration and actual SQLite replay/rate tests are separate checks.
Google account-wide free caps and negotiated volume discounts require invoice reconciliation. The request quote uses the published unit rate without platform markup.

assumptions: A dispatched provider call eventually produces an accepted, rejected or lost-response observation under weak fairness of observe(key).
The existing billing owner eventually settles an eligible reservation under weak fairness of settle(key). No provider success is assumed.
No fairness is assumed. A reserved or inflight request may remain unobserved indefinitely.
